decision: Close the threshold-only lead. Existing matched whole-import evidence rejected broad index-worker activation for JMdict, and current diagnostics do not establish a stable contrary opportunity.

history.method: Three fixed ABC/BCA/CAB measured triplets per corpus; identical A/C controls; separate predeclared warmups; complete import UI timing; no tracing; original observations retained.

currentEvidence: baseline-index-writer-phases.json preserves exact-base A/C medians and every observation across three separate cohorts. Current sidecar sizes are about 23.7 MB, with 5 and 6 writes. Index queue await is near zero; record-close medians vary from about 10 ms to 110 ms by host cohort, so those times are not pooled or treated as stable removable overhead.
remainingLimitation: The existing writer now excludes idle time from its cooperative yield budget (#844); no matched evidence shows that this changes the rejected cross-corpus activation tradeoff. Both local and worker writers use that accounting.
